game_title: Safe Get Scout – Glacier Crossing Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing, a cracking glacier: the sherpa guide must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Safe Get Scout: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Crossing: a cracking glacier
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Crossing, repeat each round: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors. Each round, frost wyrms strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the safe_lookups value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from frost wyrms in Glacier Crossing: keep the safe_lookups meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: safe_lookups drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Safe Get Scout
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Safe Get Scout' (Week 8 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Glacier Crossing'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safe_lookups changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Glacier Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 80 seconds while safe_lookups > 0.
